question: Who among the following has written the book ‘The Last Queen’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni** is an honor winning and top of the line creator, artist and dissident.
 
• Her work has been distributed generally, and her books have been converted into **29 dialects.**
 
• **The Last Queen** is a book in light of the existence of Maharani Jind Kaur last sovereign of** Punjab.**
 
• This book depends on the genuine story of Maharani Jindan, the last Sikh sovereign of **Lahore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
